description: This file provides interfaces for conversions between Python tensor objects and at::Tensor, including registration functions and creation utilities, serving as a bridge between Python and C++ in PyTorch's tensor handling code.

methods.name: registerDtypeObject
methods.description: Registers a Python object representing a data type with its corresponding ScalarType.

methods.name: registerLayoutObject
methods.description: Registers a Python object representing a layout with its corresponding Layout.

methods.name: createPyObject
methods.description: Creates a Python object from an at::Storage.

methods.name: createStorage
methods.description: Creates an at::Storage from a Python object.

methods.name: createStorageGetType
methods.description: Creates a storage, scalar type, and a boolean indicating if the storage is compatible, from a Python object.

methods.name: isStorage
methods.description: Checks if a Python object is a storage.

methods.name: getTHPDtype
methods.description: Retrieves the Python data type object associated with a ScalarType.

methods.name: getTHPLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the Python layout object associated with a Layout.
